jobs.script: Every morning starts with a choice. You can rush out the door, or you can take one quiet minute for yourself. Our ceramic mugs are made by hand in a small studio, glazed in soft earth colors, and fired twice so they last for years. They keep your coffee warm while you plan the day ahead. Pick your favorite color today, and make that quiet minute a little better.

jobs.prompt: Taylor Swift smiling and holding our ceramic mug
